title: Fixed Vector Descent Lemma
body_html:
Fixed Vector Descent Lemma

For a target point \(x'\) and a positive integer \(j\), the \(G_{x,j/m}\)-fixed part of the support subspace attached to \(B_{x,x',j/(2m)}\) is contained in a sum of support subspaces at level \((j+1)/(2m)\) over target building points with jumps in \((1/(2m))\mathbb Z\).
proof_html: Decompose the support space into cosets \(w+B_{x,x',0}\). If a coset contributes \(G_{x,j/m+}\)-fixed vectors, the generalized lattice-model action formula forces \(M(w)\) into the deeper source Lie lattice. The module function \(N_t=(w+B_0)L_{x,t+s}\) satisfies the hypotheses of supercuspidal_theta.module_function_self_dual_envelope, producing a self-dual target lattice function \(L_y\) that contains the coset at the next support level.
